title: Hearty Bitter Jamaican Tofu Stew
description: A quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring tofu, bitter flavors, and chewy texture, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot on a lazy susan spinner.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat on the lazy susan spinner.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced bitter melon and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides.
Add the thyme, allspice, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
